extracted.name: Easy milo chocolate cake
extracted.description: An easy and tasty chocolate cake you can make at home during lockdown
ingredient_lines: 3 tablespoon milo powder/any chocolate drink powder
instruction_lines: Add 1 tablespoon of hot water into the Milo powder and mix it in a bowl
Add all-purpose flour into the mixture
Mix well with a pair of chopsticks if you don't have a whisk
Add melted butter and mix well.
Grease the mold with butter and pour the cake batter into the mold
Steam it in a steamer with the highest heat for 8 minutes (the time depends on the size of your mold)
